posts.author: Essinvest
posts.text: Var jo er meget forsiktig kursmål det mtp hva det baseres på. Men gjentatt kjøpsanbefaling får vi ta. Recommendation    Buy Target Price    5,75 Share Price    4,80 Prosafe | PRS NO New Petrobras tender supports path to 2028 inflection point With its fleet of four high-end accommodation semis and a legacy moored unit, we believe the Prosafe fleet should be able to achieve USD 90-100m in EBITDA in 2028 once certain rigs roll-of legacy dayrate contracts. Key to reach this earnings level is to secure more work for Eurus and Zephyrus which are set to finish existing contracts with Petrobras in Q1/Q2 and Q3/Q4 2027, and a fresh tender from Petrobras supports the recontracting outlook. Globally, the high-spec flotel market continues to tighten with the DP3 segment seeing 84% utilization YTD, up from 72%-80% in 2024-25. We reiterate a Buy recommendation and NOK 5.75 TP, at which the share would trade at 2028e EV/EBITDA and FCF to EV yield of 4.8x and 18%, and ~14% assuming normalized capex.
